messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging alert: elevated 5xx rates observed from streaming-gateway-prod in us-west-2 for the last 3 minutes. Error spike correlates with chunked responses and client disconnects. Alert ID: INC-1967777

sam: I'm on it. grabbing logs and tailing the gateway metrics. live on call.

arjun: taking networking/egress side — will check NLB + ALB error rates and any 5xx from targets.

lina: i can run quick canary to route a small percentage away from streaming path to non-streaming endpoint. will coordinate if we need a hotfix.

dave: what's customer impact? any top-tier customers seeing timeouts? maria, can you confirm from CS?

maria: pushing a note to affected customers in parallel — waiting on confirm from telemetry, but a couple of realtime customers reported truncated streams ~1m ago.

sam: copy. initial grep of gateway logs shows a surge in 504/502 alongside some 500s and 'client disconnected' lines. snippet:```
2026-03-15T18:02:11Z upstream/stream-handler ERROR status=502 client_ip=54.72.1.3 conn_id=abc123 chunk_write_error: write tcp: connection reset by peer
2026-03-15T18:02:13Z upstream/stream-handler ERROR status=504 request_id=xyz789 backend_timeout: context deadline exceeded
```

arjun: NLB health looks fine. ALB target group reports increased 502s from streaming-service pods. No registration flaps. CPU/mem within baseline.

tina: I see a pattern: a subset of pods showing elevated socket ETIMEDOUT in kernel logs. suspect kernel-level keepalive/timeouts combined with a recent nginx change?

dave: any recent deploys to streaming-service? eng-releases, flag?

sam: checking deploy bot... last deploy 7h ago, small nginx config tweak to chunked encoding:```
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_http_version 1.1;
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
```

arjun: that matches. If chunked changes hit certain client combos, clients may cancel leading to connection resets and cause backpressure upstream.

lina: mitigation idea: flip traffic for new sessions to never use chunked (force transfer-encoding: identity) for 10% of traffic and see if errors drop. low-risk rollback if needed.

sam: executing escape hatch: deploying a per-route header override to disable chunked for streaming-route. rollout in 2m, 5% -> 25% -> 100% if it looks good.

infra-bot: deploy started: route-config/streaming-disable-chunked v2 -> canary 5% (sam initiated). CI checks passed.

sam: can everyone watch error-rate grafana panel and logs? i'll post updates.

(monitoring 30s later)

sam: update: canary at 5% shows 30% reduction in 502s for those sessions. overall 5xx count still high but trending down. moving to 25%.

arjun: ALB 502s decreased in canary target group. backend pods in canary show fewer conn resets. looks promising.

maria: CS: two enterprise customers confirm improvement for their sessions on canary. they're seeing fewer truncated streams. adding note to status page draft.

sam: rolling to 100% now. will watch for any CPU/memory or downstream latency regressions.

tina: while that rolls, i'm opening a follow-up issue to dig into the nginx chunked change and why specific kernel tcp timeouts are exacerbated. we may need keepalive tuning or fallback logic.

sam: postmortem owners: tina + arjun. timeline capture and customer impact summary will be needed. maria, can you coordinate any customer comms for those who reported incidents?

maria: yep — I'll post an interim on status.redwood.com and ping their CSMs.

dave: any need for an emergency patch to client libraries? if clients auto-retry aggressively on cancel that could amplify.

lina: good call — i'll check SDK change logs; no changes recently. but adding a note to SDK team to assess retry/backoff semantics for cancelled streams.

sam: final status: 5xx spike mitigated after disabling chunked transfer. Incident declared: resolved for now, monitoring for 30m. follow-ups assigned (tina, arjun, lina). Thanks all. :tada:

incident-bot: Incident INC-1967777 updated: status=monitoring; severity=high; assignees=[tina,arjun,lina]; sla-impact=partial-degradation.
